The results include full event details like location and notes.

date.description: The date to check. Accepts: 'today', 'tomorrow', 'yesterday', 'next monday' through 'next sunday', or YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to 'today' if not specified.

function.name: get_week_events
function.description: Returns a weekly overview of all calendar events, grouped by day. Use this when the user asks about their week, weekly schedule, or wants to see multiple days at once.

start_date.description: The first day of the week to show. Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', 'next monday', or YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 'today'.

function.name: find_free_slots

date.description: The date to search for free slots. Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', or YYYY-MM-DD.

duration_minutes.description: The minimum duration in minutes needed (e.g., 30, 60, 90, 120).

function.name: create_event

start_time.description: Start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format (e.g., 2026-03-06T14:00).

end_time.description: End time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format (e.g., 2026-03-06T15:00).

location.description: Optional: the location for the event.

notes.description: Optional: notes or description for the event.

calendar_name.description: Optional: specific calendar to add to. Uses default if omitted.

function.name: modify_event
function.description: Modifies an existing calendar event. Can change the title, time, or location. Use this when the user wants to reschedule, rename, or update an event. You need the event_id from a previous get_events or search_events call.

event_id.description: The unique identifier of the event to modify (from get_events results).

new_title.description: Optional: new title for the event.

new_start_time.description: Optional: new start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

new_end_time.description: Optional: new end time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

new_location.description: Optional: new location for the event.

function.name: delete_event
function.description: Deletes a calendar event. Only use when the user explicitly asks to remove or cancel an event. Requires the event_id from a previous query. Always confirm with the user before deleting.

event_id.description: The unique identifier of the event to delete.

function.name: search_events

query.description: The search keyword to look for in event titles, locations, and notes.

Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', 'yesterday', 'next monday', or a specific date in YYYY-MM-DD format. ALWAYS use this tool when the user asks about their schedule on any day. The results include full event details like location and notes.

date.description: The date to check. Accepts: 'today', 'tomorrow', 'yesterday', 'next monday' through 'next sunday', or YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to 'today' if not specified.

function.name: get_week_events
function.description: Returns a weekly overview of all calendar events, grouped by day. Use this when the user asks about their week, weekly schedule, or wants to see multiple days at once.

start_date.description: The first day of the week to show. Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', 'next monday', or YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 'today'.

function.name: find_free_slots
function.description: Finds available time slots of a given duration on a specific date, between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM. Use this when the user wants to know when they're free, asks about availability, or wants to find time for a meeting.

date.description: The date to search for free slots. Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', or YYYY-MM-DD.

duration_minutes.description: The minimum duration in minutes needed (e.g., 30, 60, 90, 120).

function.name: create_event
function.description: Creates a new event on the user's calendar. Use this when the user explicitly asks to schedule, book, or create an event. You can include a location and notes.

start_time.description: Start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format (e.g., 2026-03-06T14:00).

end_time.description: End time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format (e.g., 2026-03-06T15:00).

location.description: Optional: the location for the event.

notes.description: Optional: notes or description for the event.

calendar_name.description: Optional: specific calendar to add to. Uses default if omitted.

function.name: modify_event
function.description: Modifies an existing calendar event. Can change the title, time, or location. Use this when the user wants to reschedule, rename, or update an event. You need the event_id from a previous get_events or search_events call.

event_id.description: The unique identifier of the event to modify (from get_events results).

new_title.description: Optional: new title for the event.

new_start_time.description: Optional: new start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

new_end_time.description: Optional: new end time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

new_location.description: Optional: new location for the event.

function.name: delete_event
function.description: Deletes a calendar event. Only use when the user explicitly asks to remove or cancel an event. Requires the event_id from a previous query. Always confirm with the user before deleting.

event_id.description: The unique identifier of the event to delete.

function.name: search_events
function.description: Searches for calendar events by keyword in the title, location, or notes. Searches across the next N days. Use this when the user asks about a specific event by name or topic.

query.description: The search keyword to look for in event titles, locations, and notes.

days_ahead.description: How many days ahead to search (default: 30).

function.name: check_conflicts
function.description: Checks if a proposed time slot conflicts with any existing events. Use this before creating an event to ensure there are no scheduling overlaps.

start_time.description: Proposed start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

end_time.description: Proposed end time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', 'yesterday', 'next monday', or a specific date in YYYY-MM-DD format. ALWAYS use this tool when the user asks about their schedule on any day. The results include full event details like location and notes.

date.description: The date to check. Accepts: 'today', 'tomorrow', 'yesterday', 'next monday' through 'next sunday', or YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to 'today' if not specified.

function.name: get_week_events
function.description: Returns a weekly overview of all calendar events, grouped by day. Use this when the user asks about their week, weekly schedule, or wants to see multiple days at once.

start_date.description: The first day of the week to show. Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', 'next monday', or YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 'today'.

function.name: find_free_slots
function.description: Finds available time slots of a given duration on a specific date, between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM. Use this when the user wants to know when they're free, asks about availability, or wants to find time for a meeting.

date.description: The date to search for free slots. Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', or YYYY-MM-DD.

duration_minutes.description: The minimum duration in minutes needed (e.g., 30, 60, 90, 120).

function.name: create_event
function.description: Creates a new event on the user's calendar. Use this when the user explicitly asks to schedule, book, or create an event. You can include a location and notes.

start_time.description: Start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format (e.g., 2026-03-06T14:00).

end_time.description: End time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format (e.g., 2026-03-06T15:00).

location.description: Optional: the location for the event.

notes.description: Optional: notes or description for the event.

calendar_name.description: Optional: specific calendar to add to. Uses default if omitted.

function.name: modify_event
function.description: Modifies an existing calendar event. Can change the title, time, or location. Use this when the user wants to reschedule, rename, or update an event. You need the event_id from a previous get_events or search_events call.

event_id.description: The unique identifier of the event to modify (from get_events results).

new_title.description: Optional: new title for the event.

new_start_time.description: Optional: new start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

new_end_time.description: Optional: new end time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

new_location.description: Optional: new location for the event.

function.name: delete_event
function.description: Deletes a calendar event. Only use when the user explicitly asks to remove or cancel an event. Requires the event_id from a previous query. Always confirm with the user before deleting.

event_id.description: The unique identifier of the event to delete.

function.name: search_events
function.description: Searches for calendar events by keyword in the title, location, or notes. Searches across the next N days. Use this when the user asks about a specific event by name or topic.

query.description: The search keyword to look for in event titles, locations, and notes.

days_ahead.description: How many days ahead to search (default: 30).

function.name: check_conflicts
function.description: Checks if a proposed time slot conflicts with any existing events. Use this before creating an event to ensure there are no scheduling overlaps.

start_time.description: Proposed start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', 'yesterday', 'next monday', or a specific date in YYYY-MM-DD format. ALWAYS use this tool when the user asks about their schedule on any day. The results include full event details like location and notes.

date.description: The date to check. Accepts: 'today', 'tomorrow', 'yesterday', 'next monday' through 'next sunday', or YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to 'today' if not specified.

function.name: get_week_events
function.description: Returns a weekly overview of all calendar events, grouped by day. Use this when the user asks about their week, weekly schedule, or wants to see multiple days at once.

start_date.description: The first day of the week to show. Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', 'next monday', or YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 'today'.

function.name: find_free_slots
function.description: Finds available time slots of a given duration on a specific date, between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM. Use this when the user wants to know when they're free, asks about availability, or wants to find time for a meeting.

date.description: The date to search for free slots. Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', or YYYY-MM-DD.

duration_minutes.description: The minimum duration in minutes needed (e.g., 30, 60, 90, 120).

function.name: create_event
function.description: Creates a new event on the user's calendar. Use this when the user explicitly asks to schedule, book, or create an event. You can include a location and notes.

start_time.description: Start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format (e.g., 2026-03-06T14:00).

end_time.description: End time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format (e.g., 2026-03-06T15:00).

location.description: Optional: the location for the event.

notes.description: Optional: notes or description for the event.

calendar_name.description: Optional: specific calendar to add to. Uses default if omitted.

function.name: modify_event
function.description: Modifies an existing calendar event. Can change the title, time, or location. Use this when the user wants to reschedule, rename, or update an event. You need the event_id from a previous get_events or search_events call.

event_id.description: The unique identifier of the event to modify (from get_events results).

new_title.description: Optional: new title for the event.

new_start_time.description: Optional: new start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

new_end_time.description: Optional: new end time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

new_location.description: Optional: new location for the event.

function.name: delete_event
function.description: Deletes a calendar event. Only use when the user explicitly asks to remove or cancel an event. Requires the event_id from a previous query. Always confirm with the user before deleting.

event_id.description: The unique identifier of the event to delete.

function.name: search_events
function.description: Searches for calendar events by keyword in the title, location, or notes. Searches across the next N days. Use this when the user asks about a specific event by name or topic.

query.description: The search keyword to look for in event titles, locations, and notes.

days_ahead.description: How many days ahead to search (default: 30).

function.name: check_conflicts
function.description: Checks if a proposed time slot conflicts with any existing events. Use this before creating an event to ensure there are no scheduling overlaps.

start_time.description: Proposed start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

end_time.description: Proposed end time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', 'yesterday', 'next monday', or a specific date in YYYY-MM-DD format. ALWAYS use this tool when the user asks about their schedule on any day. The results include full event details like location and notes.

date.description: The date to check. Accepts: 'today', 'tomorrow', 'yesterday', 'next monday' through 'next sunday', or YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to 'today' if not specified.

function.name: get_week_events
function.description: Returns a weekly overview of all calendar events, grouped by day. Use this when the user asks about their week, weekly schedule, or wants to see multiple days at once.

start_date.description: The first day of the week to show. Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', 'next monday', or YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 'today'.

function.name: find_free_slots
function.description: Finds available time slots of a given duration on a specific date, between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM. Use this when the user wants to know when they're free, asks about availability, or wants to find time for a meeting.

date.description: The date to search for free slots. Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', or YYYY-MM-DD.

duration_minutes.description: The minimum duration in minutes needed (e.g., 30, 60, 90, 120).

function.name: create_event
function.description: Creates a new event on the user's calendar. Use this when the user explicitly asks to schedule, book, or create an event. You can include a location and notes.

start_time.description: Start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format (e.g., 2026-03-06T14:00).

end_time.description: End time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format (e.g., 2026-03-06T15:00).

location.description: Optional: the location for the event.

notes.description: Optional: notes or description for the event.

calendar_name.description: Optional: specific calendar to add to. Uses default if omitted.

function.name: modify_event
function.description: Modifies an existing calendar event. Can change the title, time, or location. Use this when the user wants to reschedule, rename, or update an event. You need the event_id from a previous get_events or search_events call.

event_id.description: The unique identifier of the event to modify (from get_events results).

new_title.description: Optional: new title for the event.

new_start_time.description: Optional: new start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

new_end_time.description: Optional: new end time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

new_location.description: Optional: new location for the event.

function.name: delete_event
function.description: Deletes a calendar event. Only use when the user explicitly asks to remove or cancel an event. Requires the event_id from a previous query. Always confirm with the user before deleting.

event_id.description: The unique identifier of the event to delete.

function.name: search_events
function.description: Searches for calendar events by keyword in the title, location, or notes. Searches across the next N days. Use this when the user asks about a specific event by name or topic.

query.description: The search keyword to look for in event titles, locations, and notes.

days_ahead.description: How many days ahead to search (default: 30).

function.name: check_conflicts
function.description: Checks if a proposed time slot conflicts with any existing events. Use this before creating an event to ensure there are no scheduling overlaps.

start_time.description: Proposed start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

end_time.description: Proposed end time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', 'yesterday', 'next monday', or a specific date in YYYY-MM-DD format. ALWAYS use this tool when the user asks about their schedule on any day. The results include full event details like location and notes.

date.description: The date to check. Accepts: 'today', 'tomorrow', 'yesterday', 'next monday' through 'next sunday', or YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to 'today' if not specified.

function.name: get_week_events
function.description: Returns a weekly overview of all calendar events, grouped by day. Use this when the user asks about their week, weekly schedule, or wants to see multiple days at once.

start_date.description: The first day of the week to show. Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', 'next monday', or YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 'today'.

function.name: find_free_slots
function.description: Finds available time slots of a given duration on a specific date, between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM. Use this when the user wants to know when they're free, asks about availability, or wants to find time for a meeting.

date.description: The date to search for free slots. Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', or YYYY-MM-DD.

duration_minutes.description: The minimum duration in minutes needed (e.g., 30, 60, 90, 120).

function.name: create_event
function.description: Creates a new event on the user's calendar. Use this when the user explicitly asks to schedule, book, or create an event. You can include a location and notes.

start_time.description: Start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format (e.g., 2026-03-06T14:00).

end_time.description: End time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format (e.g., 2026-03-06T15:00).

location.description: Optional: the location for the event.

notes.description: Optional: notes or description for the event.

calendar_name.description: Optional: specific calendar to add to. Uses default if omitted.

function.name: modify_event
function.description: Modifies an existing calendar event. Can change the title, time, or location. Use this when the user wants to reschedule, rename, or update an event. You need the event_id from a previous get_events or search_events call.

event_id.description: The unique identifier of the event to modify (from get_events results).

new_title.description: Optional: new title for the event.

new_start_time.description: Optional: new start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

new_end_time.description: Optional: new end time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

new_location.description: Optional: new location for the event.

function.name: delete_event
function.description: Deletes a calendar event. Only use when the user explicitly asks to remove or cancel an event. Requires the event_id from a previous query. Always confirm with the user before deleting.

event_id.description: The unique identifier of the event to delete.

function.name: search_events

query.description: The search keyword to look for in event titles, locations, and notes.

function.name: get_events
function.description: Returns all calendar events on a specific date, including their titles, times, locations, notes, and attendees. Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', 'yesterday', 'next monday', or a specific date in YYYY-MM-DD format. ALWAYS use this tool when the user asks about their schedule on any day. The results include full event details like location and notes.

date.description: The date to check. Accepts: 'today', 'tomorrow', 'yesterday', 'next monday' through 'next sunday', or YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to 'today' if not specified.

function.name: get_week_events
function.description: Returns a weekly overview of all calendar events, grouped by day. Use this when the user asks about their week, weekly schedule, or wants to see multiple days at once.

start_date.description: The first day of the week to show. Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', 'next monday', or YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 'today'.

function.name: find_free_slots
function.description: Finds available time slots of a given duration on a specific date, between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM. Use this when the user wants to know when they're free, asks about availability, or wants to find time for a meeting.

date.description: The date to search for free slots. Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', or YYYY-MM-DD.

duration_minutes.description: The minimum duration in minutes needed (e.g., 30, 60, 90, 120).

function.name: create_event
function.description: Creates a new event on the user's calendar. Use this when the user explicitly asks to schedule, book, or create an event. You can include a location and notes.

start_time.description: Start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format (e.g., 2026-03-06T14:00).

end_time.description: End time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format (e.g., 2026-03-06T15:00).

location.description: Optional: the location for the event.

notes.description: Optional: notes or description for the event.

calendar_name.description: Optional: specific calendar to add to. Uses default if omitted.

function.name: modify_event
function.description: Modifies an existing calendar event. Can change the title, time, or location. Use this when the user wants to reschedule, rename, or update an event. You need the event_id from a previous get_events or search_events call.

event_id.description: The unique identifier of the event to modify (from get_events results).

new_title.description: Optional: new title for the event.

new_start_time.description: Optional: new start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

new_end_time.description: Optional: new end time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

new_location.description: Optional: new location for the event.

function.name: delete_event
function.description: Deletes a calendar event. Only use when the user explicitly asks to remove or cancel an event. Requires the event_id from a previous query. Always confirm with the user before deleting.

event_id.description: The unique identifier of the event to delete.

function.name: search_events
function.description: Searches for calendar events by keyword in the title, location, or notes. Searches across the next N days. Use this when the user asks about a specific event by name or topic.

query.description: The search keyword to look for in event titles, locations, and notes.

days_ahead.description: How many days ahead to search (default: 30).

function.name: check_conflicts
function.description: Checks if a proposed time slot conflicts with any existing events. Use this before creating an event to ensure there are no scheduling overlaps.

start_time.description: Proposed start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

end_time.description: Proposed end time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

function.name: get_events
function.description: Returns all calendar events on a specific date, including their titles, times, locations, notes, and attendees. Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', 'yesterday', 'next monday', or a specific date in YYYY-MM-DD format. ALWAYS use this tool when the user asks about their schedule on any day. The results include full event details like location and notes.

date.description: The date to check. Accepts: 'today', 'tomorrow', 'yesterday', 'next monday' through 'next sunday', or YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to 'today' if not specified.

function.name: get_week_events
function.description: Returns a weekly overview of all calendar events, grouped by day. Use this when the user asks about their week, weekly schedule, or wants to see multiple days at once.

start_date.description: The first day of the week to show. Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', 'next monday', or YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 'today'.

function.name: find_free_slots
function.description: Finds available time slots of a given duration on a specific date, between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM. Use this when the user wants to know when they're free, asks about availability, or wants to find time for a meeting.

date.description: The date to search for free slots. Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', or YYYY-MM-DD.

duration_minutes.description: The minimum duration in minutes needed (e.g., 30, 60, 90, 120).

function.name: create_event
function.description: Creates a new event on the user's calendar. Use this when the user explicitly asks to schedule, book, or create an event. You can include a location and notes.

start_time.description: Start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format (e.g., 2026-03-06T14:00).

end_time.description: End time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format (e.g., 2026-03-06T15:00).

location.description: Optional: the location for the event.

notes.description: Optional: notes or description for the event.

calendar_name.description: Optional: specific calendar to add to. Uses default if omitted.

function.name: modify_event
function.description: Modifies an existing calendar event. Can change the title, time, or location. Use this when the user wants to reschedule, rename, or update an event. You need the event_id from a previous get_events or search_events call.

event_id.description: The unique identifier of the event to modify (from get_events results).

new_title.description: Optional: new title for the event.

new_start_time.description: Optional: new start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

new_end_time.description: Optional: new end time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

new_location.description: Optional: new location for the event.

function.name: delete_event
function.description: Deletes a calendar event. Only use when the user explicitly asks to remove or cancel an event. Requires the event_id from a previous query. Always confirm with the user before deleting.

event_id.description: The unique identifier of the event to delete.

function.name: search_events
function.description: Searches for calendar events by keyword in the title, location, or notes. Searches across the next N days. Use this when the user asks about a specific event by name or topic.

query.description: The search keyword to look for in event titles, locations, and notes.

days_ahead.description: How many days ahead to search (default: 30).

function.name: check_conflicts
function.description: Checks if a proposed time slot conflicts with any existing events. Use this before creating an event to ensure there are no scheduling overlaps.

start_time.description: Proposed start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

end_time.description: Proposed end time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

function.name: get_events
function.description: Returns all calendar events on a specific date, including their titles, times, locations, notes, and attendees. Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', 'yesterday', 'next monday', or a specific date in YYYY-MM-DD format. ALWAYS use this tool when the user asks about their schedule on any day. The results include full event details like location and notes.

date.description: The date to check. Accepts: 'today', 'tomorrow', 'yesterday', 'next monday' through 'next sunday', or YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to 'today' if not specified.

function.name: get_week_events
function.description: Returns a weekly overview of all calendar events, grouped by day. Use this when the user asks about their week, weekly schedule, or wants to see multiple days at once.

start_date.description: The first day of the week to show. Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', 'next monday', or YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 'today'.

function.name: find_free_slots
function.description: Finds available time slots of a given duration on a specific date, between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM. Use this when the user wants to know when they're free, asks about availability, or wants to find time for a meeting.

date.description: The date to search for free slots. Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', or YYYY-MM-DD.

duration_minutes.description: The minimum duration in minutes needed (e.g., 30, 60, 90, 120).

function.name: create_event
function.description: Creates a new event on the user's calendar. Use this when the user explicitly asks to schedule, book, or create an event. You can include a location and notes.

start_time.description: Start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format (e.g., 2026-03-06T14:00).

end_time.description: End time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format (e.g., 2026-03-06T15:00).

location.description: Optional: the location for the event.

notes.description: Optional: notes or description for the event.

calendar_name.description: Optional: specific calendar to add to. Uses default if omitted.

function.name: modify_event
function.description: Modifies an existing calendar event. Can change the title, time, or location. Use this when the user wants to reschedule, rename, or update an event. You need the event_id from a previous get_events or search_events call.

event_id.description: The unique identifier of the event to modify (from get_events results).

new_title.description: Optional: new title for the event.

new_start_time.description: Optional: new start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

new_end_time.description: Optional: new end time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

new_location.description: Optional: new location for the event.

function.name: delete_event
function.description: Deletes a calendar event. Only use when the user explicitly asks to remove or cancel an event. Requires the event_id from a previous query. Always confirm with the user before deleting.

event_id.description: The unique identifier of the event to delete.

function.name: search_events
function.description: Searches for calendar events by keyword in the title, location, or notes. Searches across the next N days. Use this when the user asks about a specific event by name or topic.

query.description: The search keyword to look for in event titles, locations, and notes.

days_ahead.description: How many days ahead to search (default: 30).

function.name: check_conflicts
function.description: Checks if a proposed time slot conflicts with any existing events. Use this before creating an event to ensure there are no scheduling overlaps.

start_time.description: Proposed start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

end_time.description: Proposed end time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

function.name: modify_event

new_end_time.description: Optional: new end time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

new_location.description: Optional: new location for the event.

Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', 'yesterday', 'next monday', or a specific date in YYYY-MM-DD format. ALWAYS use this tool when the user asks about their schedule on any day. The results include full event details like location and notes.

date.description: The date to check. Accepts: 'today', 'tomorrow', 'yesterday', 'next monday' through 'next sunday', or YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to 'today' if not specified.

function.name: get_week_events
function.description: Returns a weekly overview of all calendar events, grouped by day. Use this when the user asks about their week, weekly schedule, or wants to see multiple days at once.

start_date.description: The first day of the week to show. Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', 'next monday', or YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 'today'.

function.name: find_free_slots
function.description: Finds available time slots of a given duration on a specific date, between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM. Use this when the user wants to know when they're free, asks about availability, or wants to find time for a meeting.

date.description: The date to search for free slots. Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', or YYYY-MM-DD.

duration_minutes.description: The minimum duration in minutes needed (e.g., 30, 60, 90, 120).

function.name: create_event
function.description: Creates a new event on the user's calendar. Use this when the user explicitly asks to schedule, book, or create an event. You can include a location and notes.

start_time.description: Start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format (e.g., 2026-03-06T14:00).

end_time.description: End time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format (e.g., 2026-03-06T15:00).

location.description: Optional: the location for the event.

notes.description: Optional: notes or description for the event.

calendar_name.description: Optional: specific calendar to add to. Uses default if omitted.

function.name: modify_event
function.description: Modifies an existing calendar event. Can change the title, time, or location. Use this when the user wants to reschedule, rename, or update an event. You need the event_id from a previous get_events or search_events call.

event_id.description: The unique identifier of the event to modify (from get_events results).

new_title.description: Optional: new title for the event.

new_start_time.description: Optional: new start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

new_end_time.description: Optional: new end time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

new_location.description: Optional: new location for the event.

function.name: delete_event
function.description: Deletes a calendar event. Only use when the user explicitly asks to remove or cancel an event. Requires the event_id from a previous query. Always confirm with the user before deleting.

event_id.description: The unique identifier of the event to delete.

function.name: search_events
function.description: Searches for calendar events by keyword in the title, location, or notes. Searches across the next N days. Use this when the user asks about a specific event by name or topic.

query.description: The search keyword to look for in event titles, locations, and notes.

days_ahead.description: How many days ahead to search (default: 30).

function.name: check_conflicts
function.description: Checks if a proposed time slot conflicts with any existing events. Use this before creating an event to ensure there are no scheduling overlaps.

start_time.description: Proposed start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', 'yesterday', 'next monday', or a specific date in YYYY-MM-DD format. ALWAYS use this tool when the user asks about their schedule on any day. The results include full event details like location and notes.

date.description: The date to check. Accepts: 'today', 'tomorrow', 'yesterday', 'next monday' through 'next sunday', or YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to 'today' if not specified.

function.name: get_week_events
function.description: Returns a weekly overview of all calendar events, grouped by day. Use this when the user asks about their week, weekly schedule, or wants to see multiple days at once.

start_date.description: The first day of the week to show. Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', 'next monday', or YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 'today'.

function.name: find_free_slots
function.description: Finds available time slots of a given duration on a specific date, between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM. Use this when the user wants to know when they're free, asks about availability, or wants to find time for a meeting.

date.description: The date to search for free slots. Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', or YYYY-MM-DD.

duration_minutes.description: The minimum duration in minutes needed (e.g., 30, 60, 90, 120).

function.name: create_event
function.description: Creates a new event on the user's calendar. Use this when the user explicitly asks to schedule, book, or create an event. You can include a location and notes.

start_time.description: Start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format (e.g., 2026-03-06T14:00).

end_time.description: End time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format (e.g., 2026-03-06T15:00).

location.description: Optional: the location for the event.

notes.description: Optional: notes or description for the event.

calendar_name.description: Optional: specific calendar to add to. Uses default if omitted.

function.name: modify_event
function.description: Modifies an existing calendar event. Can change the title, time, or location. Use this when the user wants to reschedule, rename, or update an event. You need the event_id from a previous get_events or search_events call.

event_id.description: The unique identifier of the event to modify (from get_events results).

new_title.description: Optional: new title for the event.

new_start_time.description: Optional: new start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

new_end_time.description: Optional: new end time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

new_location.description: Optional: new location for the event.

function.name: delete_event
function.description: Deletes a calendar event. Only use when the user explicitly asks to remove or cancel an event. Requires the event_id from a previous query. Always confirm with the user before deleting.

event_id.description: The unique identifier of the event to delete.

function.name: search_events
function.description: Searches for calendar events by keyword in the title, location, or notes. Searches across the next N days. Use this when the user asks about a specific event by name or topic.

query.description: The search keyword to look for in event titles, locations, and notes.

days_ahead.description: How many days ahead to search (default: 30).

function.name: check_conflicts
function.description: Checks if a proposed time slot conflicts with any existing events. Use this before creating an event to ensure there are no scheduling overlaps.

start_time.description: Proposed start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

end_time.description: Proposed end time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', 'yesterday', 'next monday', or a specific date in YYYY-MM-DD format. ALWAYS use this tool when the user asks about their schedule on any day. The results include full event details like location and notes.

date.description: The date to check. Accepts: 'today', 'tomorrow', 'yesterday', 'next monday' through 'next sunday', or YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to 'today' if not specified.

function.name: get_week_events
function.description: Returns a weekly overview of all calendar events, grouped by day. Use this when the user asks about their week, weekly schedule, or wants to see multiple days at once.

start_date.description: The first day of the week to show. Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', 'next monday', or YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 'today'.

function.name: find_free_slots
function.description: Finds available time slots of a given duration on a specific date, between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM. Use this when the user wants to know when they're free, asks about availability, or wants to find time for a meeting.

date.description: The date to search for free slots. Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', or YYYY-MM-DD.

duration_minutes.description: The minimum duration in minutes needed (e.g., 30, 60, 90, 120).

function.name: create_event
function.description: Creates a new event on the user's calendar. Use this when the user explicitly asks to schedule, book, or create an event. You can include a location and notes.

start_time.description: Start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format (e.g., 2026-03-06T14:00).

end_time.description: End time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format (e.g., 2026-03-06T15:00).

location.description: Optional: the location for the event.

notes.description: Optional: notes or description for the event.

calendar_name.description: Optional: specific calendar to add to. Uses default if omitted.

function.name: modify_event
function.description: Modifies an existing calendar event. Can change the title, time, or location. Use this when the user wants to reschedule, rename, or update an event. You need the event_id from a previous get_events or search_events call.

event_id.description: The unique identifier of the event to modify (from get_events results).

new_title.description: Optional: new title for the event.

new_start_time.description: Optional: new start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

new_end_time.description: Optional: new end time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

new_location.description: Optional: new location for the event.

function.name: delete_event
function.description: Deletes a calendar event. Only use when the user explicitly asks to remove or cancel an event. Requires the event_id from a previous query. Always confirm with the user before deleting.

event_id.description: The unique identifier of the event to delete.

function.name: search_events
function.description: Searches for calendar events by keyword in the title, location, or notes. Searches across the next N days. Use this when the user asks about a specific event by name or topic.

query.description: The search keyword to look for in event titles, locations, and notes.

days_ahead.description: How many days ahead to search (default: 30).

function.name: check_conflicts
function.description: Checks if a proposed time slot conflicts with any existing events. Use this before creating an event to ensure there are no scheduling overlaps.

start_time.description: Proposed start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

end_time.description: Proposed end time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

function.name: find_free_slots

duration_minutes.description: The minimum duration in minutes needed (e.g., 30, 60, 90, 120).

function.name: create_event

start_time.description: Start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format (e.g., 2026-03-06T14:00).

notes.description: Optional: notes or description for the event.

calendar_name.description: Optional: specific calendar to add to. Uses default if omitted.

function.name: modify_event

new_start_time.description: Optional: new start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

new_end_time.description: Optional: new end time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

new_location.description: Optional: new location for the event.

function.name: get_events
function.description: Returns all calendar events on a specific date, including their titles, times, locations, notes, and attendees. Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', 'yesterday', 'next monday', or a specific date in YYYY-MM-DD format. ALWAYS use this tool when the user asks about their schedule on any day. The results include full event details like location and notes.

date.description: The date to check. Accepts: 'today', 'tomorrow', 'yesterday', 'next monday' through 'next sunday', or YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to 'today' if not specified.

function.name: get_week_events
function.description: Returns a weekly overview of all calendar events, grouped by day. Use this when the user asks about their week, weekly schedule, or wants to see multiple days at once.

start_date.description: The first day of the week to show. Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', 'next monday', or YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 'today'.

function.name: find_free_slots
function.description: Finds available time slots of a given duration on a specific date, between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM. Use this when the user wants to know when they're free, asks about availability, or wants to find time for a meeting.

date.description: The date to search for free slots. Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', or YYYY-MM-DD.

duration_minutes.description: The minimum duration in minutes needed (e.g., 30, 60, 90, 120).

function.name: create_event
function.description: Creates a new event on the user's calendar. Use this when the user explicitly asks to schedule, book, or create an event. You can include a location and notes.

start_time.description: Start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format (e.g., 2026-03-06T14:00).

end_time.description: End time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format (e.g., 2026-03-06T15:00).

location.description: Optional: the location for the event.

notes.description: Optional: notes or description for the event.

calendar_name.description: Optional: specific calendar to add to. Uses default if omitted.

function.name: modify_event
function.description: Modifies an existing calendar event. Can change the title, time, or location. Use this when the user wants to reschedule, rename, or update an event. You need the event_id from a previous get_events or search_events call.

event_id.description: The unique identifier of the event to modify (from get_events results).

new_title.description: Optional: new title for the event.

new_start_time.description: Optional: new start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

new_end_time.description: Optional: new end time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

new_location.description: Optional: new location for the event.

function.name: delete_event
function.description: Deletes a calendar event. Only use when the user explicitly asks to remove or cancel an event. Requires the event_id from a previous query. Always confirm with the user before deleting.

event_id.description: The unique identifier of the event to delete.

function.name: search_events
function.description: Searches for calendar events by keyword in the title, location, or notes. Searches across the next N days. Use this when the user asks about a specific event by name or topic.

query.description: The search keyword to look for in event titles, locations, and notes.

days_ahead.description: How many days ahead to search (default: 30).

function.name: check_conflicts
function.description: Checks if a proposed time slot conflicts with any existing events. Use this before creating an event to ensure there are no scheduling overlaps.

start_time.description: Proposed start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

function.name: get_events
function.description: Returns all calendar events on a specific date, including their titles, times, locations, notes, and attendees. Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', 'yesterday', 'next monday', or a specific date in YYYY-MM-DD format. ALWAYS use this tool when the user asks about their schedule on any day. The results include full event details like location and notes.

date.description: The date to check. Accepts: 'today', 'tomorrow', 'yesterday', 'next monday' through 'next sunday', or YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to 'today' if not specified.

function.name: get_week_events
function.description: Returns a weekly overview of all calendar events, grouped by day. Use this when the user asks about their week, weekly schedule, or wants to see multiple days at once.

start_date.description: The first day of the week to show. Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', 'next monday', or YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 'today'.

function.name: find_free_slots
function.description: Finds available time slots of a given duration on a specific date, between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM. Use this when the user wants to know when they're free, asks about availability, or wants to find time for a meeting.

date.description: The date to search for free slots. Accepts 'today', 'tomorrow', or YYYY-MM-DD.

duration_minutes.description: The minimum duration in minutes needed (e.g., 30, 60, 90, 120).

function.name: create_event
function.description: Creates a new event on the user's calendar. Use this when the user explicitly asks to schedule, book, or create an event. You can include a location and notes.

start_time.description: Start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format (e.g., 2026-03-06T14:00).

end_time.description: End time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format (e.g., 2026-03-06T15:00).

location.description: Optional: the location for the event.

notes.description: Optional: notes or description for the event.

calendar_name.description: Optional: specific calendar to add to. Uses default if omitted.

function.name: modify_event
function.description: Modifies an existing calendar event. Can change the title, time, or location. Use this when the user wants to reschedule, rename, or update an event. You need the event_id from a previous get_events or search_events call.

event_id.description: The unique identifier of the event to modify (from get_events results).

new_title.description: Optional: new title for the event.

new_start_time.description: Optional: new start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

new_end_time.description: Optional: new end time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

new_location.description: Optional: new location for the event.

function.name: delete_event
function.description: Deletes a calendar event. Only use when the user explicitly asks to remove or cancel an event. Requires the event_id from a previous query. Always confirm with the user before deleting.

event_id.description: The unique identifier of the event to delete.

function.name: search_events
function.description: Searches for calendar events by keyword in the title, location, or notes. Searches across the next N days. Use this when the user asks about a specific event by name or topic.

query.description: The search keyword to look for in event titles, locations, and notes.

days_ahead.description: How many days ahead to search (default: 30).

function.name: check_conflicts
function.description: Checks if a proposed time slot conflicts with any existing events. Use this before creating an event to ensure there are no scheduling overlaps.

start_time.description: Proposed start time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.

end_time.description: Proposed end time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM format.
